1. ## **Simple Prompting technique**

**Prompt template →**

@image1  
@image2  
@audio1 Voice reference for \[character). Match this voice exactly for their dialogue.  
@video1  
Scene context: \[Where we are, who is there, is this a long one continuous take? Technical details like lens, depth of field, add grain, etc\]  
Dialogue language: \[language, accent, delivery style\].  
CUT 1 \[framing and angle\] \- \[what happens\]  
CUT 2 \[framing and angle\] \- \[what happens\]  
CUT 3  
OR  
\[One long continuous take, no cuts\] \[what happens, describe the shot \+ all the dialogue\]  
Keep consistent: \[identities, clothing, who is holding what, which direction things are in\].

### **Example 1: A Japanese woman** 

**Input image →**  
![][image1]

**Prompt →**

@image1 — Look reference. The Japanese woman

**Scene context:** One date in Japan, early morning into night.

**Technical details:** We are the man behind the frame holding the camera. no talking. the woman is excited to meet us and wants to show us around Japan, taking us through the places a local would. She must be present in the frame at all times. If the man is shown infront of the frame like in the photobooth, blur the man's face. the man cannot have two hands present at once since at least one hand has to be holding the frame. Peope can be present in the background. Circular fisheye lens — heavy barrel distortion, everything curved and stretched toward the middle, the black curved edges of the lens barrel visible at the sides of the frame. Handheld the entire time, moving with his steps. Early-2000s camcorder look — soft video grain, blown highlights, slightly washed colour, a small date stamp in the corner. Live location sound only.

Show the whole date: meeting her at the busy japan airport where she waves and runs to us excitedly, her excitedly taking us through the entrance of a shrine with a lot of tourists. shaking out an omikuji fortune and laughing at the one we get, a convenience store run where she picks a strange drink and toss it to the basket we are holding full of japanese products, squeezing into a purikura booth together (the man's face blurred), a crane game arcade where she wins something and is extremely happy, and finally a neon lit alleyway at night where she takes our hand and leads us forward.

2. ## **Advanced Prompting technique**

**Prompt template →**

\[GOAL\]  
\[What kind of video this is, and what happens from beginning to end in one sentence.\]  
Duration: \[how many seconds\].

\[REFERENCES\]  
@image1-\[Character A's face and body. Say what to ignore, for example: not the clothing, they wear the coat below.\]  
@image2-\[Character A's coat.\]  
@image3-\[Character A's case, bag, or main prop.\]  
@image4-\[An item that goes inside that case.\]  
@image5-\[Another item that goes inside that case.\]  
@image6-\[Character B's face and body, including the clothes they wear underneath.\]  
@image7-\[Character B's hat, glasses, or accessory. Say whether it stays on the whole time or comes off at some point.\]  
@audiol Voice reference for \[character\]. Match this voice exactly for their dialogue. Do not use any other audio from it.  
@video1- \[What to take from this video: the motion, the pacing, the camera move. Then say what not to take the person, their clothes, the location.\]

Do not use any of the backgrounds from the photos.

\[CONTINUITY\]  
\[Character A\] \- \[what they look like and what they wear the whole way through.\]  
\[Character B\] \- \[same. Then anything that changes, and exactly when it changes.\]  
The scene \[one location and one lighting setup, the same from start to finish.\]

\[STAGES\]  
STAGE 1-0-\[3\]s \- \[name the beat\] \- \[what happens, and how it is framed\] NO CUT  
STAGE 2-\[n\]-\[n\]s \- \[name the beat\] \- \[what happens\] \- CUT  
STAGE 3-\[n\]-\[n\]s \- \[name the beat\] \- \[what happens\] \- CUT  
STAGE 4 \- \[n\]-\[n\]s \- \[name the beat\] \- \[how they deliver it\]. In their voice (@audio1), \[language\]: {\[the line\]} \- CUT  
STAGE 5, 6, 7... keep going until the times add up to the full duration.  
LAST STAGE CUT \[n\]-\[n\]s- \[name the beat\] \- \[the closing shot, and what stays on screen as it ends\] \- NO

If it is one continuous take instead: delete the stages and write one paragraph what happens, how the shot moves, and all the dialogue in order.

\[LOOK\]  
\[Sharpness and format, for example large-format clarity or handheld phone video.\] \[Colour and grain.\] \[Lighting and shadow.\] \[The overall mood.\]

\[CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE\]  
Cutting \- \[fast and punchy, or slow and held. Then name any camera moves you do not want.\]

\[Character A\] \- \[how they carry themselves and how the performance should read.\]  
\[Character B\] \- \[same.\]

\[AUDIO\]  
Music \- \[the style, and when it drops out.\]  
Sound \[an effect, and the moment it happens.\]  
Sound \[another effect.\]  
Ambience \- \[what is heard underneath the whole time.\]  
Subtitles \- \[on or off.\]

\[KEEP CONSISTENT\]  
Same \[character A\] and same \[character B\] throughout \[faces, clothing, and props\]. \[Anything that changes, and the stage it changes at.\] Same items in the same positions once they are shown. Same location and lighting throughout.

\[DO NOT INCLUDE\]  
\[Brand logos, extra people, text on screen, or anything else you do not want in frame.\]

### **Example 2: Cinematic Chase**

**Prompt →**

\[GOAL\]  
Cinematic scene shot with large-format IMAX clarity. An old vendor reveals his case of odd goods; a young customer in a beanie deadpans a line before removing his sunglasses and revealing his own case of equally odd items, ending with the vendor's dry reaction. Duration: 30 seconds.

\[REFERENCE MATERIAL\]  
@Image 16 defines the vendor's face/body (older, balding man), not his jacket/jeans outfit — he wears the trench below.  
@Image 1: vendor's worn trench coat. @Image 6: vendor's black aluminum case.  
In the vendor's case: @Image 2 headphones, @Image 3 gold necklace, @Image 4 tennis ball, @Image 5 pen.  
@Image 15 defines the customer's face/body (young man), incl. base grey polo/black trousers.  
@Image 13: customer's worn striped beanie (kept on throughout). @Image 8: customer's sunglasses (worn until Stage 13, then removed). @Image 14: customer's brown vintage suitcase.  
In customer's case: @Image 7 plush sun, @Image 9 rubber duck, @Image 10 mismatched socks, @Image 11 pickle jar, @Image 12 snow globe.  
@Audio 1 defines the customer's voice only, for his one line. No other audio from it.  
Do not use any photo backgrounds.

\[CONTINUITY\]  
Vendor: sly knowing smile, trench coat throughout. Customer: deadpan expression, beanie throughout, sunglasses on until he removes them in Stage 13, bare-eyed after. Scene: one dim, slightly seedy counter setting — same location and lighting throughout.

\[STAGE 1 | 0-2s | Case lands\] Vendor sets his case down, confident thud, smile forming. NO CUT.  
\[STAGE 2 | 2-3s | The smile\] Close-up on vendor's face, smile formed. CUT.  
\[STAGE 3 | 3-4s | Latches\] Close-up, his hands flip the latches. CUT.  
\[STAGE 4 | 4-5s | Lid lifts\] Close-up, lid rises. CUT.  
\[STAGE 5 | 5-7s | Reveal\] Wide push-in over the open case: headphones, necklace, tennis ball, pen. NO CUT.  
\[STAGE 6 | 7-8s | Insert: headphones\] Extreme close-up on the headphones. CUT.  
\[STAGE 7 | 8-9s | Insert: necklace\] Extreme close-up, light catching the gold chain. CUT.  
\[STAGE 8 | 9-10s | Insert: ball and pen\] Close-up on the tennis ball beside the pen. CUT.  
\[STAGE 9 | 10-11s | Customer reaction\] Cut to the customer, eyebrow raised over his sunglasses. CUT.  
\[STAGE 10 | 11-12s | The smirk\] His mouth curls into a small smirk. CUT.  
\[STAGE 11 | 12-13s | The line\] Close-up, completely deadpan. In his voice (@Audio 1), English: {I have exactly what you need}. CUT.  
\[STAGE 12 | 13-14s | Vendor's beat\] Quick cut to the vendor, thrown off for a beat by the deadpan delivery. CUT.  
\[STAGE 13 | 14-15s | Glasses off\] Close-up on the customer's hand removing his sunglasses, revealing his bare eyes. CUT.  
\[STAGE 14 | 15-16s | Bending down\] He bends down out of frame, reaching for something below the counter. CUT.  
\[STAGE 15 | 16-18s | Case lands\] His suitcase lands on the counter beside the vendor's, confident thud. NO CUT.  
\[STAGE 16 | 18-19s | Latches\] Close-up, his hands flip the case's latches. CUT.  
\[STAGE 17 | 19-21s | Reveal\] Wide push-in over the open case: plush sun, duck, socks, pickles, snow globe. NO CUT.  
\[STAGE 18 | 21-22s | Insert: duck\] Extreme close-up on the detective rubber duck. CUT.  
\[STAGE 19 | 22-23s | Insert: snow globe\] Extreme close-up, light catching the snow globe. CUT.  
\[STAGE 20 | 23-24s | Insert: pickles and socks\] Close-up on the pickle jar beside the mismatched socks. CUT.  
\[STAGE 21 | 24-26s | Vendor's reaction\] Cut to the vendor, eyebrows raised, scanning the items with amusement. CUT.  
\[STAGE 22 | 26-30s | The last word\] Medium shot on the vendor, gesturing at both open cases. English: {That's a lot of stuff right here}. Hold on both men and their cases as the scene ends. NO CUT.

\[VISUAL STYLE\]  
Large-format IMAX-style clarity: sharp, hyper-detailed, deep focus keeping both characters and cases legible, naturalistic high-dynamic-range color, fine true film grain. Dim, warm practical lighting, deep shadows, noir-adjacent mood undercut by dry humor.

\[CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE\]  
Frequent hard cuts between static shots and inserts for a punchy, dynamic rhythm — no whip pans or crash zooms, just fast, confident cutting. The customer's deadpan comes through stillness and flat tone, never exaggerated expression; the vendor's charm and dry amusement through controlled smile, raised eyebrows, steady eye contact.

\[AUDIO\]  
(Low, wry, understated noir-ish instrumental undertone, dropping out during each spoken line) \<Both cases' latches clicking open\> \<Ambient market/street murmur throughout\> \<Soft thuds as each case lands\> \<A soft click as the sunglasses fold in Stage 13\> No subtitles.

\[EXCLUSIONS\]  
Keep both faces consistent with their character sheets throughout. No visible brand logos beyond what's inherent to the reference items. Keep items visually consistent with their references.

\[MAINTAIN CONSISTENCY\]  
Same vendor (face, trench, case) and same customer (face, beanie, case) throughout; sunglasses only through Stage 12\. Same five items per case, same positions once revealed. Same counter and lighting throughout.

\[SUBJECT\]

\[DESIGN\]

\[POSE\]

\[CAMERA\]

### **Example 3: Trench coat**

**Prompt →**

*\[SUBJECT: One extremely long oversized tan trench coat designed to disguise three 68 cm creatures stacked vertically as one approximately 2-meter-tall figure.\]*

*\[DESIGN: Warm camel-tan cotton gabardine, wide structured shoulders, oversized storm collar, vintage dark horn buttons, long sleeves made for thin elongated arms, belt hanging loosely, hem nearly reaching the floor. Slight natural wear and soft fabric creases.\]*

*\[POSE: Coat completely closed and buttoned, displayed on an invisible humanoid form approximately 2 meters tall. Broad mysterious silhouette, but still slightly awkward and comedic.\]*

*\[ENVIRONMENT: Pure white seamless studio background.\]*

*\[CAMERA: Full front view, 85mm lens, f/8, sharp commercial costume photography.\]*

*\[EXCLUSIONS: No creature visible, no human body, no hanger, no logos, no props.\]*

## **Realistic generation**

### **Example 4: Dan as a singer**

**Input image →**  
![][image3]

**Prompt →**

@image1— Look reference. The singer performing on stage. Appearance only. Do not use the image background.

**Scene context:** An outdoor night concert with a massive crowd, recorded from inside the crowd.  
One long continuous take, no cuts. Handheld, held in one hand, with realistic lens breathing and natural camera shake. 4K ultra-high resolution, realistic live-action concert footage, high dynamic range, shallow depth of field, cinematic highlights, crisp skin texture and fabric texture, sweat glow on skin, stage lights and screen glow raking across faces in the dark, deep night sky above the crowd. Live sound only — the song, the crowd, screaming.

The take opens inside the crowd, the frame half blocked by cheering audience members, raised hands and rows of modern phones, some iphones, some other phones, up above the heads with their bright screens facing the stage, and the singer beyond them far on stage, mid pop song into the mic, words coherent. The camera then turns sideways to the woman standing next to it in the crowd — an American woman with blonde hair and blue eyes, close and slightly below, her face filling most of the frame, screaming along with the song, the stage lights and other raised iPhone 17 screens small and bright behind her. The camera turns back to the stage and digital zooms slowly forward through the thick crowd until the singer fills the frame. The singer holds the last note with his eyes shut and his head tipped back, the song ends and the crowd roars, he drops the mic hand to his side with his chest heaving, pushes his damp hair back off his forehead, notices the camera and breaks into a grin: {Thank you\!} He points a finger straight forward to the frame as the crowd erupts and the frame shakes hard.

Keep consistent: the singer's identity and clothing, the woman's identity and clothing, and the stage always in the same direction from the crowd.

## **UGC**

### **Example 5: Ad on bouldering shoes**

**Prompt →**

\[Product — the Raid bouldering shoe. All six images are the same single shoe. Structure, proportions, materials and colour exactly per ref.\]

@image1 — the shoe, direct side profile.

@image2 — the shoe, three-quarter front view.

@image3 — the shoe, top down.

@image4 — the shoe, underside and sole.

@image5 — the shoe, direct front view.

@image6 — the shoe, direct rear view.

**\[Climber** — the same man in all eight images. Face, hair, build, clothing and footwear exactly per ref. Do not use the image backgrounds.\]

@image7 — his face, close up, front.

@image8 — his face, close up, three-quarter.

@image9 — his face, close up, side profile.

@image10 — the back of his head, close up.

@image11 — full body, front, showing the full outfit and shoes.

@image12 — full body, three-quarter.

@image13 — full body, side profile.

@image14 — full body, from behind.

**\[Voice\]**

@video1 — voice reference for the climber. Match this voice exactly for his dialogue.

**Scene context:** A moderately busy indoor bouldering gym. The climber is filming a review of the shoes he is wearing.

One long continuous take, no cuts. Handheld phone-style video, natural camera shake, realistic lens breathing. Bright even gym lighting, coloured holds on grey walls, thick matting underfoot, shallow depth of field, crisp skin and fabric texture. Live sound only — chalk, feet on holds, other climbers talking, mats thudding in the background.

**Dialogue language:** natural conversational English.

The take opens with the climber holding the camera himself at arm's length with one hand only, his other hand by his side, walking through the gym and talking to the lens as he goes, other climbers moving past behind him: "So these Raid bouldering shoes have been going viral —" and on that word he angles the camera down without breaking stride, the frame dropping to show the shoes on his feet moving across the matting, and he keeps talking over the shot of them: "— and you guys know me, I'm serious when it comes to these things, so..." He brings the camera back up to his face, slows, bends forward toward a chest-height ledge and sets it down — the frame drops, wobbles, and settles into a static shot facing out at the gym. He steps back into frame, adjusts his stance and finishes the thought: "...I'm gonna test these and give you my honest opinion." He turns, walks to the wall, claps his hands together once and pulls onto a moderate boulder problem, climbing it realistically — pressing the front of the shoe onto small footholds, smearing the toe flat against a blank sloped section and holding it, then standing up on that foot and reaching a hand to the next hold, stepping his feet up after it, pulling through to a higher hold with his hips close to the wall, resetting his feet once more, and finally reaching through to the top hold and matching both hands on the finish. He drops from the wall onto the mat, absorbs the landing, brushes his hands off on his trousers and walks back toward the camera, bending forward until his face fills the frame, nodding slowly, his voice slightly amused because he did not expect them to be this good: "Okay, these Raid shoes are pretty legit."

**Keep consistent:** one climber only, his identity and face throughout, the faded washed-black t-shirt, the baggy olive-brown linen trousers with gathered elasticated cuffs, the dark ribbed socks, and the same black and red climbing shoes on both feet in every shot.
